purpose: Start and supervise an explicitly reviewed set of Linux owner processes.
responsibility_boundary: Own only the documented product/interface scope. Reuse applicable managed common components without forcing unrelated dependencies. Separate synthetic source acceptance from actual account, data and deployment acceptance.

packages.description: Hatter exact process incarnation, handshake and availability policy
Exact Hatter owner incarnation and volatile availability contracts

steps.name: Check the selected unit and isolate public dependency configuration
steps.run:
case "$SELECTED_PACKAGE" in hatter-owner-contracts|hatter-owner-runtime) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == workflow_dispatch ]]; then
  [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/heads/main && "$EXPECTED_SOURCE" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$EXPECTED_SOURCE" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]
fi
echo "CARGO_HOME=$RUNNER_TEMP/public-cargo-home" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$RUNNER_TEMP/public-cargo-target" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Install the declared Rust toolchain
steps.run: rustup toolchain install 1.97 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy

steps.name: Validate both workspace libraries
steps.run:
cargo +1.97 fmt --all -- --check
cargo +1.97 clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo +1.97 test --locked --workspace --all-features

steps.name: Generate and build the selected registry package
Record exact source and distribution bytes
steps.run:
mkdir outgoing
cp "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/package/$SELECTED_PACKAGE-0.10.0.crate" outgoing/
printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > outgoing/source-sha.txt
cd outgoing
sha256sum "$SELECTED_PACKAGE-0.10.0.crate" > SHA256SUMS

evidence_policy: Declarations and source paths are not proof of an executed acceptance. Exact CI head and result are recorded separately. No live accounts or production acceptance is inferred.
